title: Grilling skills: start the PRD writer after map done, and share tickets cleanly between agents
summary: The agent that closes the last ticket can now start the PRD writer itself, two grilling agents on one laptop no longer claim the same ticket, and a stopped meeting tab or a left ticket no longer locks or repeats tickets for other agents.
friction: The confirming review took about 5.9 hours, almost all of it waiting for the machine-wide gate lock while other sessions ran their suites; meanwhile four stories merged to main and the branch needed a conflict round in five files

deferred.what: The PRD writer tells the agent to run /grillo-score in the same agent, but grillo-score keeps disable-model-invocation: true (pinned by its test), so no PRD version written by the map-done rule ever gets its score file
deferred.why: A different skill outside this story's seam, and its own test pins the flag

deferred.what: A no-session ticket hold outlives its owner when Grillo did not see the tab stop (Grillo crashed, or /grillo-answer N was run by hand), so every agent on that laptop refuses ticket N until someone deletes .git/meeting-holds/ by hand
deferred.why: Needs a design decision: a single-instance lock or stale-hold detection; the runbook documents the manual step

deferred.what: On the host's laptop a live-session agent holds under meeting-holds/<session id>/ while an own-time agent holds under meeting-holds/no-session/, so both can hold and grill the same ticket at once
deferred.why: Outside this story's criteria (outside a meeting) and needs a choice of which folder both check
